rules.rule: CRM owns service records; AutoStop App owns Store data; Gmail and Telegram own their messages and media. Manager keeps only routes, cross-system rules, technical cursors, refs and compact verified lessons. Never persist raw business records, private identifiers, message bodies, financial ledgers, credentials or secrets.

Command routing alone selects ordered workflows, effects, connector needs and write policy. Knowledge lookup only selects documents and cannot grant a write, external send, financial authority or connector access. The configured project surface is the live 24-tool CRM Gateway; the standalone 77-tool Manager registry is internal inventory and production imports only its required subset. codex_apps/autostopcrm.* and unconfigured account App namespaces are legacy and must not be used or reported as project failures.

Every mutation requires an exact focused reread, ActionContractV2, non-mutating dry-run, apply with a different idempotency key and concurrency controls, then independent exact reread. Unverified outcomes remain compensating.

Payments, cashboxes, refunds, payroll, supplier orders, financial totals, destructive actions and external recipients require exact owner authority. Invoice email delivery additionally requires exact recipient, verified sender, attachment SHA-256, successful QA and separate confirmation for tax or financial mismatch.

Multi-step work uses the Gateway v2 ledger with compact state-versioned checkpoints. Store only refs, hashes, booleans and safe summaries; resume the newest unfinished run before starting a duplicate.

Preserve dirty work and remote history. Never reset, rebase, force-push, restart services or deploy unless the active owner request explicitly includes that action; release preparation alone leaves deployment pending.
